Rust JavaScript package manager
Usage: jsm [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]
Commands:
  init
  add
  install
  remove
  run
  exec
  list
  why
  config
  store
  versions
  doctor
  lock
  completion
  help
Options:
      --cwd <CWD>              [default: .]
      --json
      --quiet
      --verbose
      --offline
      --prefer-offline
      --store-dir <STORE_DIR>
      --registry <REGISTRY>
      --no-color
      --non-interactive
      --progress <PROGRESS>    [default: auto] [possible values: auto, ndjson]
      --config <CONFIG>
      --trace <FILE>           Write a Chrome trace for diagnostic runs
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version
